mapper.update: UPDATE sys_social_callback_event SET process_status = 'PROCESSING', claimed_by = #{workerId}, claim_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (process_status = 'PENDING' OR (process_status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_time IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_time <= NOW())) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, connection_id, app_config_id, event_id, dedup_hash, event_type, event_time, signature_status, payload_cipher, process_status, retry_count, next_retry_time, error_code, error_summary, claimed_by, claim_time, create_time, update_time FROM sys_social_callback_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND process_status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_by = #{workerId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_social_callback_event SET process_status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} THEN 'DISCARDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END, next_retry_time = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} THEN NULL ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(POW(2, retry_count + 1), 60) MINUTE) END, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, claimed_by = NULL, claim_time = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND process_status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_by = #{workerId}
